payload.core_mechanism_summary: DP with state (tree index, groups so far, last color) minimizing cost. Uses min1/min2 per (index, groups) to avoid O(m) color iteration, typical 2D DP optimization.
payload.rationale: The DP state hinges on two main dimensions (position i and group count j), with an auxiliary color dimension. The solution tracks best two values per (i,j) to accelerate transitions, fitting the dp_2d_state pattern.
